author: Ricardo Nogueira Garcia
releaseNotes: v2.2.0: liquidDepthMax now means sensor-to-maximum-level distance (same as the cloud driver); volume uses installationHeight - liquidDepthMax; single calibration command with the corrected formula; new liquidDepthMaxCalc and maxWaterHeightM attributes. v2.1.0: Tuya protocol 3.5 support.

x-catalog.description: Local driver for Tuya Wi-Fi ultrasonic tank level sensors (port 6668, protocols 3.3, 3.4 and 3.5), with no Tuya Cloud. Level, water column and alarm state, plus optional volume calculation.
